answer: The ferrous counter is kept in basalt and echo makes public each reset. A hostile operator thus has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 44 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 44 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. That bill is paid per identity, so 286 aliases cost 201 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
